title: Old Gregor
kicker: a lucid old skeleton who remembers one name and one debt
hook: a lucid old skeleton who remembers one name and one debt

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: An old dwarf-miner skeleton wears a battered cap, a corroded locket, and brass charms over a beard that somehow still remembers its braid.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: A gentle ghost of a craftsman wearing a soldier's command like ill-fitting borrowed clothes. Carries a carved toy with one missing wheel. Wants, beneath the whole weight of the debt, only to remember enough of his life to stop obeying it.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A way forward A grounded question A scene-specific clue seed
